def overlappedInterval(intervals):
    # Sort intervals based on the starting point
    intervals.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    
    # Initialize the merged intervals list with the first interval
    merged = [intervals[0]]
    
    # Iterate over the remaining intervals
    for current in intervals[1:]:
        # Get the last interval in the merged list
        last_merged = merged[-1]
        
        # Check if the current interval overlaps with the last merged interval
        if current[0] <= last_merged[1]:
            # Merge the intervals by updating the end point of the last merged interval
            merged[-1][1] = max(last_merged[1], current[1])
        else:
            # If no overlap, add the current interval to the merged list
            merged.append(current)
    
    return merged
